text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that the applicant and his group distributed rods, clubs, armature, Molotov cocktails, metal structures considered projectile cold weapons, firearms and ammunition to some of those taking part in the demonstrations at Freedom Square.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that the applicant, using his army commander's experience and his standing acquired during the fight for liberation of Artsakh and his influence among veterans of the Nagorno Karabakh war, declared during the demonstrations at Freedom Square that he would struggle until the end and demanded that demonstrators be ready to take decisive steps.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that the applicant incited those recruited in the town of Hrazdan and adjacent villages to participate in the demonstrations held in violation of the law, acting as their personal commander and leader.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that the applicant regularly circulated at Freedom Square accompanied by bodyguards and companions-in-arms as a show of strength to arouse the crowd.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that between 27 and 29 February 2008 the applicant organised the transportation of wooden and metal clubs, armature and Molotov cocktails to Freedom Square, where they were hidden in tents designated as 'Hrazdan', 'Kotchor' and 'Vanatur'.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that on 29 February 2008 operative information was received by the Armenian Police and the National Security Service that a group of persons intended to instigate mass disorder in Yerevan on 1 March 2008 through provocations and that a large quantity of clubs, metal rods, explosive substances, firearms and grenades were to be distributed among participants of the assembly at Freedom Square.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that in the early morning of 1 March 2008 the police tried to discover illegal items at Freedom Square and to prevent their use, and as a result of the police operation part of the objects brought for the purpose of carrying out mass disorder, including firearms and ammunition, were discovered at Freedom Square.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that thereafter participants of the assembly, led by the applicant's group, gathered in the area adjacent to the Myasnikyan monument, an important intersection of several streets of Yerevan situated in the vicinity of the French, Italian and Russian embassies.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that at around 11 a.m. on 1 March 2008 the participants of the mass disorder blocked Grigor Lusavorich street by placing trolleybuses along the carriageway and armed themselves with stones, rods, sticks, explosive substances, explosive devices, firearms and Molotov cocktails.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that Molotov cocktails were filled with flammable liquid immediately behind the platform at the Myasnikyan monument and in the nearby park.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that the applicant and others rejected the offer made by the authorities to hold the assembly in another location and, with their speeches and orders, gave instructions to the gathered crowd with the aim of keeping it there as long as possible.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that from 1 to 2 March 2008 mass disorder was perpetrated in the area of the Myasnikyan monument and the Yerevan Mayor's Office, as well as Grigor Lusavorich, Mashtots, Leo and Paronyan streets, with use of firearms, ammunition and explosive substances and devices, during which armed resistance was shown to the police and servicemen of the Police Troops.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court found it established that a total of 187 persons, including 32 civilians, sustained injuries as a result of the mass disorder of 1-2 March 2008.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court specified the number of persons injured and killed and vehicles damaged, as well as the pecuniary damage caused to the police, the city of Yerevan, the central district and private businesses as a result of the mass disorder of 1-2 March 2008.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: The Kotayk Regional Court concluded that the mass disorder of 1-2 March 2008 had stopped only after the declaration of a state of emergency and its prevention by the actions of the police.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: As regards the charge of illegal possession of ammunition and explosives, the Kotayk Regional Court found that the applicant had obtained the items in question at an unidentified time and illegally kept them in his restaurant's storage room.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: In reaching its conclusions, the Kotayk Regional Court relied, inter alia, on the statements of the witnesses who had appeared in court and the pre-trial statements of witnesses T.K., V.S. and G.A.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: As regards the pre-trial statements retracted in court, the Kotayk Regional Court found that the witnesses in question, as the applicant's companions-in-arms, friends and residents of his area, had retracted their statements because of being familiar and close with the applicant, and decided to give preference to their pre-trial statements.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: On 22 July 2009 the applicant lodged an appeal against his conviction.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: On 31 July 2009 the Criminal Court of Appeal dismissed the applicant's appeal against his conviction.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: On 31 July 2009 the Criminal Court of Appeal upheld the judgment of the Kotayk Regional Court.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: On 30 August 2008 the applicant lodged an appeal on points of law.
section_path: THE FACTS
II. THE CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE APPLICANT

text: On 10 September 2009 the Court of Cassation of Armenia declared the applicant's appeal on points of law inadmissible for lack of merit.
